name: The vest
blurb: Cross the waves only after the vest. The vest is worth the walk.
aside: The top of the page is a dry walk, 15 steps, with the treat and the stick at C1. It never takes the vest, and it scores −13. The water is 13 steps and takes the stick at E7. That line scores −11. The ball at E4 is two steps off the water line, and that walk scores −10. It is the best line. All three reach the flag.
